claims.independent_kernel_overlap_status: NOT ATTEMPTED, not merely unmeasured. This engine serialises every call into llama.cpp behind one lock because llama.cpp contexts are not thread safe, so there is no concurrent submission for a profiler to find. Separately, the tool that could verify overlap if it were implemented (Nsight Systems) is not installed. Throughput gains from batching are not evidence of overlap.
claims.throughput_gain_source: continuous batching: more sequences per fused kernel launch, not more kernels running at once
